tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[conjugate loci of the sphere and ellipsoid] 1. ch5:3.4↗ def:dc-ch5-3-4

On $S^n$, $C(p)=\{ -p\} $, for all $p$. The case of $S^n$, however, is not typical. A more typical example is given by the ellipsoid, where $C(p)$ is, in general, a curve with four singular points (see Fig. 4 of Chap. 13; cf. Braunmühl, A., "Geodätische Linien auf dreiachsigen Flächen 2-Grades", Math. Ann. 20 (1882), 557-586). \end{example}
